data: For the fiscal year ended June 30, 2025, Microsoft reported revenue of $281,724 million (about $281.7 billion) and net income of $101,832 million (about $101.8 billion). Revenue in the prior fiscal year (ended June 30, 2024) was $245,122 million, so fiscal 2025 revenue grew by roughly 14.9%, an increase of about $36.6 billion. Net income rose from $88,136 million in fiscal 2024, a gain of about 15.5%, and diluted earnings per share increased from $11.80 to $13.64.
